description: South African ID number validation: checks a 13-digit SA ID number (date of birth, citizenship digit and Luhn checksum) and decodes date of birth, age, gender and citizenship status. Structural check only, with no Home Affairs lookup; the number is not stored. Useful for KYC and onboarding forms and for catching typos. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).
name: za_validate_id_number
title: South African ID number check: validate and decode an SA ID number
